overview:
**Fire danger is High today, driven by dry fuels (ERC 74%, BI 62%) even as scattered afternoon showers move through.**
- Danger eases to Moderate Wed–Fri as rain chances build, then climbs back to High by Sat–Sun as fuels dry out again.
- Today's weather: a chance of showers and thunderstorms with gusty south winds; Wednesday brings a 60% chance of rain, adding helpful moisture.
- No Red Flag Warning is active, and 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met.
- Fire restrictions remain: BLM Stage 1 covers Gunnison, Hinsdale, Montrose, Ouray, San Miguel and Saguache counties; Delta and Ouray counties are also under county Stage 1, though GMUG National Forest lifted its restrictions Sept. 3.
- Nearby: the Elk Fire on the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forest (Hinsdale/Gunnison area) is 73% contained at 7,257 acres with minimal activity.
